UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Google user profile, custom identity, and synced app settings for SoundLapa

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in Google user

displayName.description: User display name or custom nickname

email.description: Optional user email (private to owner only)

photoUrl.description: Optional avatar URL or compressed JPEG data URI

avatarBlocked.description: Whether custom avatar uploads are blocked for this account

listeningStatsJson.description: Compact JSON array of 365-day daily listening events for cross-device stats sync

settings.description: Cloud-synced SoundLapa preferences (language, theme, accent color, crossfade, haptics, cache, data saver)

isOnline.description: Whether user session is currently in foreground

lastActiveAtMs.description: Client epoch milliseconds when presence or playback state changed

currentTrackCoverUrl.description: Compact cover artwork URL of currently loaded track

currentTrackIsPlaying.description: Whether audio playback is currently playing

currentTrackUpdatedAtMs.description: Client epoch milliseconds when now-playing track info changed

appVersion.description: Installed SoundLap app version string reported by the client

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp)

BugReport.title: BugReport
BugReport.description: User-submitted bug report with reporter display name, avatar, message, triage status, and timestamp

reporterName.description: Display name of the reporter at submission time

reporterAvatarUrl.description: Optional avatar URL or compressed data URI of the reporter

status.description: Developer triage status for the report

createdAtMs.description: Client epoch milliseconds when report was sent

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when report was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp)

updatedAt.description: Optional server timestamp when developer updated report status (FieldValue.serverTimestamp)

AvatarModerationRequest.title: AvatarModerationRequest
AvatarModerationRequest.description: Manual avatar change request reviewed by developer (SL-D1E6-EE60) or moderator (SL-C526-964C)

userId.description: Requester Firebase Auth UID (matches document ID)

currentPhotoUrl.description: Optional current active avatar URL or data URI before approval

proposedPhotoUrl.description: Proposed cropped avatar JPEG data URI awaiting manual moderation

rejectReason.description: Optional reason provided by moderator when rejecting the avatar

reviewedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the moderator or developer who reviewed the request

reviewedByName.description: Display label of the moderator or developer who reviewed the request

createdAtMs.description: Client epoch milliseconds when request was submitted

reviewedAtMs.description: Client epoch milliseconds when request was reviewed

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when request was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when request was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp)

SavedTrack.title: SavedTrack
SavedTrack.description: User-saved, liked, or playlist-referenced track metadata persisted across app updates

sourceUri.description: Optional remote stream or resolver URI

isUserUpload.description: Whether track was uploaded by user

trackCreatedAtMs.description: Client epoch timestamp when track was added

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was updated

UserPlaylist.title: UserPlaylist
UserPlaylist.description: User-created or imported playlist persisted in cloud

isPinned.description: Whether the playlist is pinned to top of library

pinnedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when playlist was pinned

sortMode.description: Track sorting mode inside the playlist

playlistCreatedAtMs.description: Client epoch timestamp when playlist was created

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was updated

UserPlaylistItem.title: UserPlaylistItem
UserPlaylistItem.description: Ordered track entry inside a user playlist

CloudMetrics.title: CloudMetrics
CloudMetrics.description: Zero-PII per-user Firestore storage byte usage summary for developer quota monitoring

storageBytes.description: Estimated serialized Firestore byte footprint for this user's cloud documents

tracksCount.description: Count of cloud saved track documents

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when metrics were updated

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Zero-PII public user profile visible to authenticated SoundLap users for social discovery

UsernameHandle.title: UsernameHandle
UsernameHandle.description: Unique @username reservation mapping lowercase handle to owner UID

UserFriend.title: UserFriend
UserFriend.description: Friend link inside authenticated owner's private friend list

BanRecord.title: BanRecord
BanRecord.description: Developer-managed account ban record preventing banned users from accessing cloud data

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile, custom identity, and synced settings for SoundLap Google Sign-In account

/users/{userId}/tracks/{trackDocId}.description: User's saved, liked, and playlist tracks synced across installs and updates

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistDocId.description: User's playlists synced across installs and updates
Ordered tracks belonging to a user's playlist

/public_profiles/{userId}.description: Zero-PII public profile projection searchable by authenticated users

/usernames/{handle}.description: Unique lowercase @username directory mapping to userId

/bug_reports/{reportId}.description: User bug reports queried and triaged by verified developer

/avatar_requests/{userId}.description: Manual avatar moderation requests reviewed by developer (SL-D1E6-EE60) and moderator (SL-C526-964C)

/cloud_metrics/{userId}.description: Aggregated cloud byte usage per user for developer storage monitoring

/banned_users/{userId}.description: Server-enforced ban records created/removed exclusively by verified developer
